candidate.answerReason: The top is the sum of the three bottom numbers plus the middle number. Its maximum is 33 and its minimum is 7, both attainable, giving a difference of 26.

methods.label: Track each bottom number
methods.explanation:
The middle bottom number enters both sums in the second row, so it contributes twice to the top. Each outside number contributes once. If the bottom numbers from left to right are \(a,b,c\), the top is
\[
(a+b)+(b+c)=(a+b+c)+b.
\]
The three different one-digit positive integers have sum at most \(7+8+9=24\), and the middle number is at most \(9\). Thus the top is at most \(24+9=33\). This is attained by the bottom row \((7,9,8)\), which gives second-row numbers \(16,17\) and top number \(33\).

Similarly, the bottom numbers have sum at least \(1+2+3=6\), and the middle number is at least \(1\). Thus the top is at least \(6+1=7\). This is attained by the bottom row \((2,1,3)\), which gives second-row numbers \(3,4\) and top number \(7\).

Both bounds are attained, so the requested difference is
\[
33-7=\boxed{26},
\]
choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
